suggestion.title: Draft replies to the emails you open?
suggestion.why: You drafted 2 short acknowledgement replies to emails in the last few minutes

widget.name: Draft Reply Button
plan: Strategy: DOM only (no network operations were captured). Add a 'Draft reply' button right after the Reply link in the open email.
When you click it, read the subject (h2.hP), sender name and address (.gD/.go) and the message body (.a3s).
Open the reply composer with the Reply link if it is not already visible, then wait for the 'Message Body' text box.

Ask the AI for a 1-2 sentence acknowledgement that greets the sender by first name and mentions the subject and a follow-up day. Automated senders like newsletters or no-reply addresses get a neutral greeting instead.
Insert the text into the reply box and confirm it appeared. Watch for the 'Draft saved' indicator. Never click Send.
